Fig. 1. Multimodal graph-RAG architecture. Three evidence sources are retrieved independently and fused late into a single generation prompt. The knowledgegraph and visual branches (dashed) are ablated independently, giving the four systems compared in Table II: the baseline uses neither, +KG and +multimodal add one, and +both adds each. Neither branch alters text retrieval, which is why Recall@3 is identical across all four systems on text and multi-hop questions.
